messages.subject: URL generation in Shiny
parts:
I am generating links to static HTML pages hosted on (local) shiny-server within an output table in a shiny app. Since the table is generated every time from user's search inputs, I am creating the links on the fly based on search results. The generated links include an addition to the path (changing with every session):  e.g. http://myServer.org/myApp/app095c75e71384b9d0dd0018637b10fa00/myStaticPage.html . Is it possible to generate a stable link that is fixed for all users and app sessions, ideally without meaningless strings in the middle?

This is the code snippet I use to generate the link:

#server.R:

output$res=DT::renderDataTable({
    res=res.table()
    
    #processes the name string to extract the reference name in the HTML page
    toLink.fun=function(z){
      if (length(grep("/",z,fixed = T))>0) {
        splitz=strsplit(as.character(z),"/")
        zLink=splitz[[1]][2]
      } else {zLink=z}
      paste0("<a href='",zLink,"_info.html' target='_blank' >",z,"</a>",collapse = "")
    }
    
    res[,1]=sapply(res[,1],toLink.fun)
    res=DT::datatable(res, escape=-2)

    return(res)
})


#ui.R:

DT::dataTableOutput('res')


Thanks,

Edith
